high_level_description: This image is a political map of the United States that illustrates the results of an election. The map is divided into states, each colored to represent the party that won the electoral votes for that state. The states are color-coded as follows: Red: States won by Donald Trump (Republican) Blue: States won by Kamala Harris (Democratic) Light Red/Pink: States where the Democratic candidate was leading but did not win The top of the image shows two candidates with their respective party affiliations and the number of electoral votes they have received: Kamala Harris (Democratic) has
